requirements.quote: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Aerospace Operations, or a closely related business or technical field.

At least 10 years of experience in materials management, warehouse management, supply chain management, or a similar role. This must include 8+ years of progressive leadership in warehouse operations and inventory management in aerospace, defense, or commercial space launch.
Proven experience managing a spread-out inventory network that includes central manufacturing hubs, remote field or launch sites, and fast-paced line-side or point-of-use (POU) replenishment cells.
Direct experience building, training, and managing a multi-shift team of warehouse managers, material control specialists, and logistics personnel under strict safety guidelines.
Knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and best practices (e.g., AS9100, OSHA, ITAR/EAR, DOT/HAZMAT).

items.notes: DEGREE required (Bachelor's). FIT requirements quoted from full posting. SALARY: not stated in employer posting or this source (benefits listed, no base pay/currency/period). Observed via zerogtalent.com mirror of posting; original Indeed blocked. Location variants Briggs/Bertram TX.
